chunks: They will be one more army vanquished among the many routed hordes.

key_terms.الْأَحْزَابِ: the parties or groups (often referring to disbelievers)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the fate of the disbelievers' armies in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a foreshadowing of the ultimate triumph of the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful over their adversaries, drawing parallels to the Battle of Badr and the victory of Imam Ali at Khaybar. It underscores the historical pattern of divine support for the righteous against the 'parties' (al-Ahzab) of disbelief, reinforcing the concept of divine justice (Adl) in Islamic theology.
